rows.grounds: present participle describing the goddess as holding the attributes mentioned in the preceding verses
fused form combining an optative verb of recollection with an indeclinable expressing constancy
compound adjective indicating the goddess is revered in the northern transmission

items.question: How should the practitioner continually recollect the goddess honored in the northern tradition?
premises: The goddess is described as bearing the previously stated attributes.
The goddess is honored in the northern tradition.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should continually remember the goddess, bearing those attributes, as honored in the northern tradition.
uncertainties: The precise scope of uttarāmnāya within this witness is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: One should constantly remember her, bearing those forms, as honored in the northern tradition.
